people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: and they brought up the ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent; these the Levitical priests brought up.
translations.bsb: and they brought up the ark and the Tent of Meeting with all its sacred furnishings. The Levitical priests carried them up.
translations.kjv: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.
translations.asv: and they brought up the ark, and the tent of meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent; these did the priests the Levites bring up.
